game.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl
game.blurb: Open-world first-person survival shooter set in the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone, from GSC Game World, released 2024-11-20. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story of the Zone
chapters.summary: The prologue and the main story missions. Most of these achievements are hidden. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Gunfights and Mutants
chapters.summary: Headshots, long shots, trick kills, grenades, explosions and hunting every kind of mutant.

chapters.title: Stealth and Zone Tricks
chapters.summary: Covert kills, clearing camps quietly, using anomalies against enemies, and surviving big falls and chases.

chapters.title: Survival, Trading and Gear
chapters.summary: Food, status effects, trading, spending coupons, and enhancing and repairing gear.

chapters.title: Exploring the Zone and Artifacts
chapters.summary: Uncovering the whole map, campfire gossip, artifacts, arch-artifacts and enhancement flash drives.

collectibles.name: Clincher
collectibles.where: 100 enemies shot in the head. Not bad for a head start…

collectibles.name: Goodnight
collectibles.where: Get 20 covert kills. The Zone likes it quiet.

collectibles.name: On the go
collectibles.where: Bread and sausage — Zone's most popular sandwich recipe.

collectibles.name: Tit for tat
collectibles.where: Sidorovich's worst nightmare: buy and sell goods for the exact same amount of coupons in one deal.

collectibles.name: First touches
collectibles.where: First equipment enhancement. Never the last, for most Zone folks.

collectibles.name: The good, the bad and the ugly
collectibles.where: 5 headshots in 10 seconds. Good eye.

collectibles.name: Bingo
collectibles.where: Experience the effects of bleeding, sleep, hunger, alcohol, radiation and psi. Doesn't sound pretty.

collectibles.name: Zone's deadliest predator
collectibles.where: Kill a mutant of every kind. You'll need a bigger wall to fit all those trophies!

collectibles.name: Pump it up
collectibles.where: Fully enhance any type of weapon. Somewhere out there, a Zone technician just shed a tear of pride..

collectibles.name: The four winds
collectibles.where: Unlock the whole map. Few folks know the Zone this well.

collectibles.name: Taking it for granted
collectibles.where: Gear broken beyond repair. Don't forget to pay regular visits to the technician.

collectibles.name: Miracle hoarder
collectibles.where: Collect all artifacts. What about arch-artifacts?

collectibles.name: Curiouser and curiouser!
collectibles.where: Collect all arch-artifacts. A priceless collection, arguably too weird, even by Zone standards.

collectibles.name: No obstacle too big…
collectibles.where: Kill 50 enemies through obstacles. No one in the Zone is really safe.

collectibles.name: BOOM!
collectibles.where: 20 enemies killed by blowing up the surroundings. Save on hand grenades and enjoy the fireworks.

collectibles.name: Personal approach
collectibles.where: One fight, four enemies, killed by different weapons. That trick would charm the hell out of Mavka!

collectibles.name: Loner shooter
collectibles.where: Shoot an enemy in the head from 75 meters. No scope-peeking!

collectibles.name: Merry-go-round
collectibles.where: Drop a corpse into the Whirlgig anomaly. A joy for someone who never got to ride the Ferris Wheel.

collectibles.name: Keeping your hands steady
collectibles.where: Shoot an enemy in the head, through an obstacle, having the intoxication effect.

collectibles.name: Catching up
collectibles.where: Shoot an incoming grenade to make it explode. Nice view!

collectibles.name: Flash Royal
collectibles.where: Gather all armor and gear enhancement flash drives.

collectibles.name: Wiped out
collectibles.where: Kill a Rodent using a grenade launcher. A good wipe-out makes the Duty proud.

collectibles.name: Can opener
collectibles.where: Use a knife to kill an enemy wearing an exoskeleton. Epic battle indeed.

collectibles.name: Coupons to burn
collectibles.where: Spend over 1,000,000 coupons. Myklukha and Sidorovich will fight hard over their favorite customer.

collectibles.name: Bouncy
collectibles.where: A successful jump from a 30-meter height. No parachute, though.

collectibles.name: Run, stalker, run!
collectibles.where: That Chimera made you run like an Olympic champion!

collectibles.name: Peace and quiet
collectibles.where: Kill everyone in the camp before the alarm is set off. They couldn't see it coming!

collectibles.name: Proxy
collectibles.where: Kill a squad that just finished off another squad and won the fight. Or so they thought…

collectibles.name: Lockpick
collectibles.where: Lure a mutant into an anomaly. Hardly a noble deed, but it gets the job done.

collectibles.name: Welcome to the Zone
collectibles.where: Prologue complete, but this is so far from over.

StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (stalker.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://stalker.fandom.com/wiki/S.T.A.L.K.E.R._2:_Heart_of_Chornobyl
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl" or "S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2", and a StrategyWiki search for "STALKER 2" found nothing related. stalker.fandom.com answers the API, with about 47 linked pages, including "Skif", "Great Swamps", "Pripyat", "Lab X-18", "Duty", "Freedom", "Ecologists", "Bandits" and many development "Build" pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1643320 is "S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl". 45 of 76 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter; their order and meaning were not checked. Some hidden names ("Freedom of Choice", "This is our Duty", "The times of Freedom") echo faction page names on Fandom; whether they mark different story paths was not checked. The only visible story achievement is "Welcome to the Zone" (prologue complete). RAWG lists PC and Xbox Series X|S only, and a playtime of only 7 hours, which looks low for an open-world game.
